    To beginBerry ricotta brioche toastsRicotta, honey and berries, for BeastieHow to make it125g blackberries125g raspberries1 tbsp honey1/4 cup mint leaves, torn250g ricotta8 slices of briocheToss the blackberries and raspberries with the honey and torn mint.Whip the ricotta until smooth.Toast the brioche slices and cut into squares.Cut the squares.Spread with ricotta and spoon the berries on top just before serving.Diaval's black olive tapenadeBlack olives, dark as Diaval. Raven, wolf, horse, dragonHow to make it250g pitted black olives2 tbsp capers1 garlic clove1/2 lemon4 tbsp olive oil1 baguetteBlitz the olives, capers, garlic, lemon juice and a splash of oil until rough.Slice the baguette and brush with oil.Toast until crisp.Spread the tapenade thickly on the toasts.Thorn wall parmesan pepper twistsPuff pastry with grated cheese and rosemary twisted into spiky sticks, baked crisp, smoky tomato dipHow to make itNot on tonight's cookPuff pastry twisted with parmesan, black pepper and rosemary into spiky thorny sticks, baked crisp and golden, with a smoky tomato dip.Brush 2 thawed puff pastry sheets with beaten egg and scatter with 60g finely grated parmesan, 1 tsp cracked pepper and 1 tbsp chopped rosemary.Press in, cut into 1.5cm strips and twist each tightly.Bake on lined trays at 200°C for 12 minutes until crisp.For the dip, simmer 250ml passata with 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 crushed garlic clove for 10 minutes.Toasted soda bread with smoked butterKnotgrass, Thistlewit and Flittle burnt the first batch.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.From the hearthKing Stefan's crackling pork roastPork, crackling and apples. Stefan took her wings for a crown.How to make it2kg pork shoulder2 tbsp sea salt flakes4 green apples, halved1kg potatoes, in chunks2 tbsp olive oil2 bunches of broccoliniScore the pork skin and rub with salt.Leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry out.Roast at 160°C for the first part of the cooking.Chop the potatoes and halve the apples, toss with oil, and add to the pan.Roast for the last hour.Blast at 240°C until the crackling bubbles.Rest the pork.Steam the broccolini and serve on a long platter.Godmother's cottage shepherd's pieYou're my Fairy Godmother, says AuroraHow to make itNot on tonight's cookLamb mince simmered with onion, carrot, thyme and Worcestershire until rich, under fluffy cheesy mash baked golden and crunchy on top.Brown 800g lamb mince, then add 1 diced onion and 2 diced carrots and cook 5 minutes.Stir in 1 tbsp plain flour, 2 tbsp tomato paste, 1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce, thyme and 400ml beef stock, and simmer 25 minutes until thick.Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk.Spread the lamb in a dish, top with mash, scatter with 60g cheddar and bake at 200°C for 25 minutes.Sweet thingsAurora's christening cakeJam and cream sponge. Wakes only to true love's kissHow to make it250g butter, softened250g caster sugar4 eggs250g self-raising flour120g strawberry jam300ml thickened cream250g icing sugar3 tbsp milkpastel food colouring, a few drops1 punnet edible flowersBeat the butter and sugar until pale, add the eggs one at a time, then fold in the flour.Divide between 2 tins and bake at 175°C.Cool completely.Whip the cream to soft peaks.Stack the layers with jam and cream.Mix the icing sugar and milk, tint in pastel colours, ice the cake and decorate with edible flowers.Mugs and cupsMaleficent's green fire matcha lime fizzMatcha, honey and lime over ice with cucumber ribbonsHow to make it2 tsp matcha powder100ml warm water3 tbsp honey3 limes1 Lebanese cucumber1/4 cup mint leaves1 L sparkling water4 cups iceWhisk the matcha with the warm water until smooth and frothy.Stir in the honey and the juice of 2 limes.Peel the cucumber into ribbons.Fill glasses with ice, cucumber ribbons and mint leaves.Divide the matcha mix between the glasses and top slowly with sparkling water so it swirls green.Stir gently and serve with a lime wheel.
